reviews.text: Buddy had a tooth removal and the staff went above and beyond to answer all my questions and make us and buddy feel safe. They are quick to respond to messages and questions.
Allie Barker, the other vets and the support team are great. Know their stuff. Gracious and kind.
Great experience overall
I brought in my dog Jack that we adopted from a shelter a week ago. The staff were incredibly helpful, friendly, patient and gentle. The Dr was excellent and answered all my questions.
I’m so thankful for Dr. Diaz. My cat needed 21 teeth removed and he was able to do it all in one go! We got home less than two hours ago and he is already purring!
Everyone was very helpful. There was no waiting after I arrived and the Doctor took time to explain her diagnostic and the treatment options.
I love Modern Animal and so appreciated Dr. Diaz’s care, expertise, thorough communication and timely updates on my baby! Incredibly grateful I finally found a vet spot that I love and trust.

This place is fantastic.
My dog is paralyzed and they took their time to make sure he was very comfortable and cared for during his exam.
I had been going to the same vet for 30 years and switched to Modern recently. I am so happy I did.
Their ability to keep costs down is so well appreciated in this economy.

EDIT: They are good but I don't like how money hungry they are getting and wont refill your pets medications. They trickle them on and on and on. I'm sick of it too bad there is a subscription to them or else I would've gone somewhere else

ery good doctors and they are quick to answer questions via app. They are super responsive.
On time and friendly

We had a great visit with Modern Animal to check out my male cat's spraying problem. The offices were clean and we didn't have to wait too long to be seen. They checked him out thoroughly, gently and were great when I had questions. Got him all his necessary shots and a prescription for anxiety meds. As with all vet visits, it was a little more $$ than I thought, but that is with any medical thing ever, haha. Would highly recommend if you need a thoughtful doc for your pet.
Great care and intuitive questions.

The team is wonderful.  I was in so much distress and they helped me feel grounded and supported. I appreciate that they squeezed me in when i went to the wrong location too,amazing team. My dog Lola had the best care and I'm excited to continue her care at Modern Animal! Dr Brecker is a wonderful pitbull lover and helped me understand all my options clearly.
Booking the appointment was a breeze. Was able to get an early AM same day appt for an overnight emergency. Quick, reasonably priced service. My pup is on the mend and recovering well.

Best vet experience I’ve ever had by far. Finally a vet who really paid attention to what my dog needed and gave us a treatment protocol that is WORKING (after the thousands of dollars spent in working with other vets). The membership model is great when you really need a vet that cares and works with you like you are family. Thank you thank you thank you. I look forward to the follow up appointment, with the improvement that has happened in just a few days, I know we’re going to be celebrating in two weeks!

We had such a great experience at Modern Animal. The space is super clean, beautiful, and honestly feels like a little luxury experience for pets. The team was really kind and welcoming, and when we came in for our first visit, they even gave our dog a toy, which was such a sweet touch. It made the whole visit feel really thoughtful and special. So happy we found them!

Had a great experience with staff and didn't feel pressured to get more tests then I felt necessary for my 16 year old cat. Kind and communicative people work there, glad I went ahead and bought the annual membership.
Attentive staff. Fast appointment. Great level of care. Plenty of parking.

I really liked the facility. Super clean, very friendly stuff, professional personal. High tech equipment.  All records and charts always available online. Which make communications easy.  Highly recommend
The staff is always super kind to my dogs! Especially my big nervous boy. Visits can be really expensive, but they give a lot of care to their animal clients.

I had such a great experience at this vet clinic! Dr. Barker and Rye were both incredibly helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. They took the time to walk me through everything and made sure I had all the information I needed for my three cats. I never felt rushed, and they answered all of my questions with patience and care. You can tell they truly care about the animals and their clients. Overall, amazing service—I left feeling confident and well taken care of. Highly recommend!

From start to finish, my puppy's visit to Modern Animal was an absolutely wonderful experience and I couldn't recommend it more highly!

The entire staff had the best attitudes; everyone was warm, welcoming, and genuinely helpful from the moment we walked in. What sets Modern Animal apart is that it truly lives up to its name; it's modern, fresh, and nothing like your typical vet clinic. The vibe is hip and contemporary, and the space itself is spotless.

I really appreciated their tiered membership options, which allow you to choose a plan that best fits your situation, a thoughtful touch that shows they care about accessibility. Parking is also a breeze with a dedicated lot behind the location, which is always a plus.

Most importantly, the actual vet visit was thorough and unhurried. Everything was explained in detail, and I never once felt rushed. If you're looking for a vet that combines modern care, a great atmosphere, and a team that truly takes the time to make both you and your pet feel valued then Modern Animal is the place to go. My puppy Chewie was very pleased and loved all the attention.

Christian and Bella are the best! Christian the vet assistant was so calm and nurturing to my cat Candy. I feel like other vet offices I’ve been to (before Modern) haven’t had the same “it’s ok we got you” vibe. I’ve historically been expected to navigate/lead the visit by holding the cat which is fine of course, but Modern always takes charge in the softest way and Christian really made us all feel safe. He held her still, he spoke gently, and he looked very comfortable doing so. It was such a treat to have someone take lead when I’m feeling so sad my kitty isn’t well (just an ear infection lol but still!)

And Bella! So nice and helpful. Somehow my husband, my one year old, and my cat all had an ear infection at the same time and she heard that I was stressed about my one year old and she took special interest to fit us into an appointment that worked for us. Her enthusiasm to accommodate our personal needs was such a breath of fresh air.

My family really appreciates this office - the staff, the coffee they keep in the fridge for guests, and of course the vet docs too! Great team all around.

I deeply regret trusting Modern Animal with my dog’s care. Unfortunately, I have now had two very concerning experiences with this clinic involving my 4-pound Pomeranian, Leo.

In January 2026, I brought Leo in because he was clearly in pain while trying to defecate. The visit summary shows that the clinic recommended fiber (psyllium husk) and probiotics, but no one suggested that the issue could be related to anal glands, even though painful defecation was already occurring.

After the appointment, my boyfriend took Leo outside the clinic and he screamed again while trying to poop. My boyfriend immediately went back inside to inform the staff that Leo was in severe pain, but no further diagnostic steps were taken and they simply provided a probiotic.

Two months later, Leo’s condition worsened significantly. We were told that both anal glands were infected and one had already ruptured, requiring sedation and treatment. According to their own message, the right anal gland had already ruptured by the time the procedure was performed.

For this treatment we were charged $630 just to clean and treat the anal glands, which is extremely high considering Leo weighs only 4 pounds and one gland had already partially drained due to the rupture.

This was not the first alarming experience we had with this clinic. A few months earlier, Leo was prescribed two strong pain medications, including Meloxicam, for what was described as a mild issue. The risks were not adequately explained. Shortly after taking the medication, Leo became extremely ill with severe gastrointestinal symptoms, including vomiting and diarrhea.

The clinic later documented that his condition was likely related to a side effect of the medication, but by that time I had already needed to seek emergency veterinary care in the middle of the night because of how sick he became.

When I attempted to schedule an urgent follow-up appointment the next day, the clinic initially told me there was no availability. Only after I insisted and made clear that the situation was serious did an appointment suddenly become available.

While they did waive the cost for one day of treatment after acknowledging the medication reaction, Leo remained sick for three weeks, and we had to return again and pay another $400 for fluids and treatment. My boyfriend and I both had to take time off work to care for him.

As a lawyer, I value accountability, transparency, and professional responsibility. Unfortunately, my experiences with this clinic left me feeling that those standards were lacking. The prices are extremely high, communication about risks was insufficient, and the level of care did not match the cost.

I would strongly encourage other pet owners to carefully consider their options before trusting this clinic with their pet’s care.

Best Vet clinic in LA! I tried several clinics before finding Modern Animal and really appreciate their care and attention to detail.

I had 1 cat and 3 dogs (the cat has recently passed) and all my pets have been in their care for 3+ years. When my cat passed, Modern Animal supported me through the whole process and even followed up with a card and flowers. I have never encountered such empathy from my vet before.

One of my dogs has a difficult case of IBD and his doctor at Modern Animal was able to help me identify this and also point me to a specialist that eventually healed my dog.

I trust them with the life of my pets and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a qualified and caring vet.

I absolutely love Modern Animal in Studio City. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the clinic itself is clean, chic, and thoughtfully designed.

Their app is a game changer. It makes scheduling appointments seamless, reviewing visit notes easy, and keeping all of Bodi’s medical information organized in one place.

Best of all, Bodi genuinely loves going and that’s the biggest win of all!

Modern Animal Studio City has truly been an answered prayer for our little pack of pups. We’ve been there so often (senior pets get sick often) that it feels like the team are people we know and distant family lol. So seriously, THANK YOU.

Bella at the front desk is the absolute best. She is always so kind, calm, and welcoming, even during the most stressful visits. Practice Manager Ariel took the time to give me a tour of the space and was so loving and generous with her time. Thank you, Ariel! Every single vet tech, such as Casey, have taken care of us like our dogs are the most important celebrity dogs. Thank you for treating our babies with so much love, both us the parents and our pups feel the loving energy you carry every time.

Every vet we’ve seen has been incredible. Dr. Phan, Dr. Patty when she was there, and Dr. Van Zant have all been heroes to us. Please forgive me if I am forgetting any names. We’ve had some really close calls with one of my pups (Simba) and this team has gone above and beyond every single time. Their compassion, patience, and genuine care mean more to my husband and I than we could ever put into words.

Everything from the app to the in person appointments has been such a comforting, seamless experience. We are so deeply grateful to have this team caring for our babies. We truly appreciate them so so much! THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU!!!!!

I have been going to Modern Animal with my pup since 2021. I love that I have options, as in locations, to chose from if the locations closest to me does not have available times. Studio City location is close to home and the staff are amazing. I always recommend them to people I know.
This is what they did to my cat after a dental procedure

Could not have been nicer, and more explanative.
Great experience.

Extremely happy about our care at Modern Animal. I’m really happy I can get a consultation anytime in the app. Super convenient location, great parking, clean facility. They were wonderful with my cats, thank you for your hospitality!

Awful! You cant reach them by phone. You cant make an appointment except through their app which my phone doesn't have space for. I had to delete my banking app and Lyft to download it temporarily and it was so glitchy I couldnt get their messages and they couldnt get mine. I wasted 400$ just to have them tell me what I already knew and told them and then hound me for what the vet from over half a decade ago said. I still have no solution and my cat is dying. He is barely clinging to life now, literally wasting away in front of me bc they did not help him. Dont go here. They FORCE you to use their bad app and then use it as an excuse to not send off test I told 3 separate people to send. The poor communication is astounding! The obstacles they set up to prevent communication is clearly intional to try and get more money out of you. They left me 3 hours and 45 min via email in the middle of a work day to send off a sample I told them 3 times to send, then when I tried to reach them several different ways I couldnt get through so now they exepct me to pay for an entire new round of tests that I already paid for. Your animal will die before getting proper care here.

They care more about making money than helping your pet.

I took my Doberman who had a cough to them for a chest x ray. I literally told the doctor I think my dog has pneumonia. After taking the chest x ray the doctor and radiologist both said my dog had no fluid showing in his lungs and that they see his heart is enlarged and to book tests with a cardiologist. they sent us home. 24 hours later my dog was in critical condition...I took him to the emergency where they took x rays again which showed extremely severe pneumonia, no enlarged heart but instead collapsed lung tissue and so much fluid in his lungs that he turned septic...My dog passed away. I went back to look at the x rays they sent me and it is very clear there was fluid showing in his chest. I called to ask for at least a refund on the x ray and our visit since my dog ended up passing away from pneumonia which they claimed he did not have...his heart was also never enlarged. Modern Animal refused to refund me and continued to lie to me about his x rays. The least they could have done is refund me for my visit and the x rays for giving me false information about my dog who passed away 24 hours later... They couldn't even do that.

I do not recommend modern animal for your pet ever. they care more about making money then telling the truth and helping your pet. I lost my best friend and they covered up their mistakes and continued to lie to me and didn’t even help me out with the bill.

Our experience with Modern Animal Studio City was devastating and traumatic.

We signed up as new clients and enrolled in their "unlimited" membership plan, trusting their promises of modern, premium care. A week after our first visit, we lost our 9.5-year-old Frenchie, Butters — my best friend and the love of my whole life. He died suddenly on October 16, just over a week after what was described as an "extremely thorough exam" with a $2,000+ invoice.

After reviewing his medical records, I understand the warning signs were unmistakable and documented. Had they communicated urgency, we would have done absolutely anything to pursue additional care that might have changed the outcome.

October 7 visit:

Butters came in for labored breathing and was sleeping upright. We showed them a video of collapse episodes — alarming symptoms. Their clinical notes listed cardiac arrhythmia as a possible cause. We expected this would trigger cardiac testing. None of this was done.

The radiologist's report explicitly recommended a sedated laryngeal exam. This exam was never scheduled. The vet never conveyed this recommendation or communicated any urgency. He was continued on long-term Carprofen without standard monitoring bloodwork for senior dogs.

His follow-up was booked a week out — for a senior, brachycephalic dog with documented respiratory disease and collapse episodes. They didn't raise concerns. They didn't convey urgency.

The same day as his scheduled follow-up, Butters stopped breathing at home and passed within five minutes. He never had the cardiac workup. He never had the airway exam their own radiologist recommended.

We brought his body to the clinic. They placed me in a cold, quiet room. I waited 2.5 hours. No one from leadership came out. No one expressed urgency. It was the worst experience of my life.

After being told to wait 45 more minutes, I went to the lobby and had to explicitly say: "My dog had a thorough exam a week ago, and now he's dead. I need to know what happened."

Almost 3 hrs later, another vet offered vague theories for cause. No personal call from the examining vet. No conversation from the medical director. We received a condolence card two weeks later — which was appreciated, but came after deafening silence when our grief was raw.

We had to repeatedly chase down lab results & radiology reports we'd paid a premium for, promised as "expedited." Some remained marked "processing" a week after his death.

Then in late November — right after my partner posted an honest review — Modern Animal suddenly reached out, sounding concerned. The timing was striking: silence in our darkest moment, action only when their reputation was at stake.

They also never offered reimbursement for the $199/year membership we'd had for just one week before losing our dog.

Butters presented with textbook warning signs for serious cardiac and respiratory disease. The radiologist made urgent recommendations in writing. The $2,000 exam generated critical diagnostic findings — yet none of these expert insights were communicated to us or acted upon with appropriate urgency. The data was never used to inform his care.

I'm not saying the clinic was definitely at fault. But the failure to communicate what their own diagnostics revealed was complete. The experience was transactional.

For a clinic marketing itself as premium at premium prices, the care and professionalism fell devastatingly short.

Butters was my best friend, constant companion, my son, and love of my life. Losing him, especially so drastically and following what happened after, is something I know will never fully recover from.

Other Frenchie parents and owners of medically fragile or brachycephalic dogs deserve to know our experience so they don't have to go through what we're still dealing with. Our other Frenchie, Bao, is now at ValueVet under Dr. Werber — where we've experienced genuine expertise and compassion.

If you have a dog with specialized needs, please think carefully before Modern Animal Studio City.
This place is an absolute gift. We love everyone here and trust them with our baby!

My dog Butters went to Modern Animal (Studio City) because he seemed “off” for a couple of weeks. We did every test they recommended and were told that nothing looks alarming. About a week later, he passed away. I’m not a vet, so I’m not blaming Modern Animal for his passing, but what happened afterward was incredibly upsetting.
We brought Butters back to them for help with cremation and to get a basic explanation. Even though we had an appointment, we waited almost 2.5 hours in a room, holding our deceased dog in our arms, before a vet came in. The staff’s attitude and communication on one of the worst days of our lives felt cold and dismissive.
Another important point: we had just paid for the annual membership, and Butters only visited the clinic once before he died. No one even offered to discuss a partial refund. On top of that, in my experience their prices were about 240% higher than other clinics for comparable exams. Don’t be fooled by the “unlimited visits” pitch — you may end up paying much more overall. Based on this experience, I would not return to or recommend Modern Animal.

I’ve been going here for a few years now. I love the quality that my cat gets! Everyone is so warm and loving there! It is on the pricey end of vets (I pay for the all access membership - it more than covers all my appointments for my cat. I honestly just go for anything wrong with my cat because I pay for it). But the quality of service that I get - to me - the price is more than justified. The app is easy to use. I like that they also offer tele vet services through it. So no matter where I go, if I need assistance. They are a few finger tips away!
Very happy with Modern Animal! I took my Pluto (Sphynx male cream kitten) and they were professional and accommodating.

This was our first time visiting this clinic with our new family addition and rescue boy, Scout. The team greeted us immediately. Our originally scheduled doctor was sick, however, the clinic got us in with a new doctor immediately. The doctor and nurse gave us all the information they could discern about Scout’s wellness - and gave Scout loads of tasty, healthy treats. They even have free human treats in the lobby. I felt like we weren’t just another customer. They truly wanted to make sure we felt confident about our rescue and were very informative. And it was clean! Scout is already looking forward to his next scheduled visit :)
The most efficient way to deal with your pets needs is by using Modern Animal. Professionalism and care of all the staff is unmatched.

I took my dog in for a second opinion on o this office after taking her to another place. I think the place is good and clean, but I don’t like that they lack a lab on premise to do fecal testing but charge so much to send it out when Vetcos prices for the same process is much cheaper if you’re going to charge a premium I would like the lab to turnover next day results.

As well I did appreciate them not muzzling her and listening to me and she seemed to like this place better. I also appreciate the app process it makes scheduling so easy.

The only other negative I will say is suggesting more tests for imaging and bloodwork when I stated we had fleas and it made sense to wait for the fecal test before stressing out my dog first before stressing her out with further exams and blood work.

Also, she is 14 so with older dogs I think it’s a good idea to be realistic on how much stress you want to put them under and I’d like more consideration taken into the age of the animal. Other than that I wouldn’t mind going back, but I do think for places like this that do need to turn a profit as it’s backed by Venture Capital doing your own research is a good idea or if you’ve had a lot of dogs before to know what will work best for you and your animal.

Only other note is they currently don’t offer the new flea shot that last 12 months I think it’d be great if they stayed up to date on their drug trends and offered them to guests who would be interested in it overall oral or topical options.
Dr Van Zandt was great! And so was Alvin!!

Stuff is not helpful. They are trained to give you textbook answers and pretending to be helpful but in reality they don’t care about your pets at all. They are good actors rather than good vets.  I took my cat for spay today and after the surgery there are some bloods coming out. I tried to chat with them in the app and no one responded in 2 hours . I called emergency number and no one answers for 20 mins. It‘s difficult to imagine how they take care of your pets in a true emergency . I have to drive to the vet again and see a group of 10 people in the vet but none of them are able to answer any of my question in the app. Also they insisted app is the best way to contact for any question but there is no one responds to your message. Don’t take your pet to here for spay.

Thank you Bella and the amazing team at Modern Animal. I am a millennial pet mom and have at atrocious experiences at vets. They can be cold, uncaring, and money hungry. I get it’s a business and we all gotta eat- but our fur babies are more than just walking money pits- they are family. Modern animal is clean, warm, and welcoming. Their pricing is transparent. They communicate with you constantly during an app. Bella at the front desk has been so kind, and gentle with my pet children. Pricing is a little bit more than what I’m used to paying however, the convenience, the communication, the kindness, and the expertise make all the difference. I consider it a convenience charge and I’m here for it. Thank you for your Modern Animal- you rock!
Modern always provide an excellent service and the doctors along with the staff are very friendly. They treat my baby with such care

The entire staff was excellent-super loving, well organized & very knowledgeable.  From front desk to Dr., I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.  We were passing through LA relocating to NZ and Willow my dog was having some pain & limping in her legs.  modern staff kept her most all day doing their do diligence to find out what the problem was, treatment care plan, medication & helpful info on what I need to talk to the new vet in NZ about.  Incredibly detailed notes, diagnosis & steps for rehab, medication & things that need to be addressed as well as the plan, time frame & urgency.  SUPER IMPRESSED!  Worth the membership fee!  App allows you to chat with docs & staff, request refills, ask questions, etc.
We've been with several vets at Modern Animal. She was great, her communication excellent and we left with no questions unanswered.
Thank you for taking such good care of Merlin on his visit September 2nd.  He is doing well.
We sadly had to release our sweet dog of 14 years to sweeter pastures. They were very compassionate and helpful making a difficult experience easier.

Took my dog Indi has been a patient for 6 months and has been in twice this week for a severe cough. They did two X-rays, told me nothing was wrong, and sent me home with probiotics. I later had to rush her to the emergency vet, where she was diagnosed with serious bronchitis on the verge of pneumonia and put on two antibiotics. I spent $1,400+ here for them to dismiss a life threatening illness. Deeply negligent care, and I would never trust them with my pet again. I’m appalled by the quality of care.

i had very high hopes for this vet because other locations have been recommended to me by friends. i’m not sure if they’re just overbooked at this location or what the issue is but dr connor greeted us by saying that we were running late so needed to get through the appointment as quickly as possible, which really rubbed me the wrong way as it was my first time meeting her. there were 3 other dogs in the waiting room when we arrived and we were the ones who had to wait to see a doctor so i’m not sure why we were blamed for that or why she thought that was a good way to build rapport with a new patient. we were also told we would receive a follow up report from dr connor with supplement recommendations for my dogs condition but never heard from her again. they either don’t care or just have too much going on but we will not be returning. they also told me my dog needed follow up appointment but when i asked about scheduling it they said they couldn’t do it for me because they were all on lunch break. such a disappointing experience. i spent $600 with a vet i would never go back to. my advice is to check out a different location.
staff are awful at his location, avoid if possible

This is the first time my boy has been completely relaxed in a vet office. He was wagging his tail the entire visit and everyone was so nice to greet him!

I love that Dr. Diaz listens without interrupting, explains everything clearly, and pauses several times to ask if you have questions. Every staff member we interacted with was friendly and welcoming.

We were given a tour of the entire facility at the end of our visit, which made us feel even more comfortable bringing our boy back here. Definitely recommend giving them a visit!
Great care for Ace. The whole office loves what they do!

Love going to Modern Animal. It’s easy to make an apt, check results, and get copies of all documents. This is my first time at the studio city location (usually go to Culver City or playa vista) and had a great experience. Parking was convenient and staff was so sweet.
Modern Animal , is a great place to take your four legged best friend, the care and service is good, and professional, l recommend..

If you’re a dog lover, then you know how much we cherish and adore our fur babies. Modern Animal’s doctors and staff feel the same way. The care and love with which they treat our pets is beyond price. Dr. Diaz and his staff did an amazing job with my dog, and thanks to them, she has bounced right back to her usual self! Thank you! ❤️

I could tell that it was a very busy day And staff seemed to be a little under stress, but Cesar remained professional and showed a lot of care for my dog. He was able to identify what was wrong and provided a solution.

Amazing Experience! Modern Animal is a fantastic place to take your pets for all their needs! I 100% recommend and have a great experience every time I go. Super knowledgeable, friendly, compassionate and efficient! Thanks Modern Animal and special thanks to Dr. Diaz and Dr. Van Zant! 😁 …
Amazing experience at Modern Animal! Thanks so much and especially to Dr. Diaz and Dr. Van Zant! Absolutely recommend Modern Animal!

Let my dog go without necessary medicine without informing me that there was a shortage. When I explained the urgency of the situation I was told they could not help me because I was violating their guidelines of not typing in capital letters when dog could literally die without this medication.

HIGHLY recommend both Dr. Barker and Modern Animal. Dr. Barker is incredibly kind, smart, and thorough. She’s a doctor that TRULY cares about her patients and their families. She consistently goes above and beyond, providing A+ care. The clinic itself is very organized and accommodating. My dog has been given both dog toys and water while waiting for appts, which he appreciated. 😊The app makes scheduling and communication very easy.
Hi Yosef, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Great staff.
The MA Studio City staff are so professional, knowledgeable & caring. I have had but amazing experiences with each visit. They take such good care of my senior kitty!
Dr. Diaz was great! Got a same day appointment using the app and was put at ease by the vet's recommended treatment.
Wonderful experience and found the team to be extremely kind, attentive and thorough. So glad we found Modern Animal!
Everyone was nice, it was easy to set up an appointment, I LOVED that you can go in with your dog if they need shots or other things - you're part of the process.
Everyone is so patient and kind. My dog is always shaking and anxious when he goes to the vet and the team of techs at modern animal are amazing. We love Denise!!!
So thorough, kind and competent.

this place has gone downhill. waiting room is super small - always 4 or 5 dogs and chaos inside. Super hard to get appointments due to overcrowding - and now they're giving away 500 free all access memberships. avoid

My experiences with Modern Animal, especially at their Studio City branch, are consistently a pleasure. The doctors and staff are genuinely friendly, welcoming, kind, and patient with both me and my pets. During this recent visit, I had the pleasure of seeing Doctor Patty and Ramon, both of whom were absolutely wonderful. Highly recommended!
Hi marissa, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

Unfortunately, this was the second time in three days that I had to take Django to Modern Animal. My experiences with this clinic have been really wonderful  Dr. Katrina Van Zant explained everything to me and spent a lot of time talking to me about the problems involved. I really appreciated her warmth, kindness and knowledge. I’ve had wonderful experiences all around. I just wish that the vet that had seen Django only 2 days before had found the sores on the tongue. Who knows what the cause of that was but overall, I’d recommend them highly.

I had literally the best experience here YET AGAIN! I went in to get my dog's nails trimmed and it was so smooth, short and sweet. Everyone is so so nice and professional and treated my dog so amazing. Love Modern Animal so much!
Courteous, clean, friendly, short wait to see the vet. Veterinarian (especially Alexandra Barker) and staff go above and beyond. It’s a pleasure to bring my girls to see their favorite Vet.
My dog and I both love Modern Animal! The staff is lovely and patient. My dog goes into the office happily with his tail wagging! Would highly recommend for so many reasons!

It’s a subscription based service that’s more interested in booking inefficient repeat visiting than actually helping your pet. I can’t recommend unfortunately. You’ll end up wasting a lot more time than if you had just gone to see a normal vet :(
Great clinic! It was easy to schedule an appointment, the staff were friendly and helpful and the vet was very professional. If you’re a new customer, use REFER50-Z2P6Y when signing up for $50 off.

Modern Animal was the most convenient and affordable option for my dog and I wasn’t expecting that based on how new and bougie it looks. Dr Kang was thorough and honest on what was needed to help my dog alleviate his allergy symptoms. I also was recommended by my dog trainer and immediately received $50 off my visit and more discounts in person! Will most likely sign up for their membership and for sure be back! $50 off with REFER50-PGZYX when you sign up!
Hi Yume, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Hi Andrew, thank you for your review. If you have any additional feedback you’d like to share directly with our team, please reach out to hello@modernanimal.com. We hope to see you again soon!

The absolute best first experience with a new veterinary clinic for our new puppy that we could have hope for! Dr Conner & Nurse Dior are outstanding, kind & didn’t rush at all. We will be bringing our two 10 year old dogs in there now too. The membership is worth it if you see the vet more than twice a year and with a puppy & 2 senior dogs that’s a given. Cathy at the front desk is spectacular too & helped me add my husband to our profile in the app. Everyone there loves what they do and cares about pets and their wellbeing and it shows. HIGHLY recommend!
Hi Fernando, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

Modern Animal really stands out to me because of their app that allows for easy scheduling. I felt that the online experience matches the in-person one in that everything is very clean cut with the user in mind.

Wait times can be a little long but once you're seen by a vet or technician, it's always quick. The technicians are so friendly and clearly love animals. I like that you are invited to be present with your pet for minor things like urinalyses.

Modern Animal is on the expensive side but I appreciate that they are very accessible, with facilities to handle emergency situations/surgeries, so I would recommend coming here for that, and perhaps going elsewhere for routine shots/wellness exams.

However, it is nice that the app acts as a one stop shop of all your pets' visits, doctor's notes, upcoming vax needs, diagnoses, etc.
